title: sprinkled-causal-set-settling
description: A Lorentzian causal settling whose underlying causal set is obtained by Poisson sprinkling: events are sampled from a Poisson process on a Lorentzian manifold and the causal order is induced from the manifold. It refines lorentzian-causal-settling into a family parameterized by manifold, sprinkling density, and sampling volume, forming the corpus's bridge to the continuum Lorentzian limit.

manifold.description: the Lorentzian manifold (M, g) sprinkled into, most commonly d-dimensional Minkowski space R^{1,d-1}

density.description: the sprinkling density rho > 0, the intensity of the Poisson process per unit volume

volume.description: the volume V = Vol_g(W) of the finite-volume sampling region W, giving expected event count N = rho * V

poissonSprinkled.description: the event set E is a sample from the Poisson point process on W with intensity rho d Vol_g, so E[|E|] = rho V

inducedFromManifoldOrder.description: e1 < e2 iff e1 precedes e2 in the manifold's causal order; the manifold causal structure restricted to E supplies the causal set

lorentzInvariantInLaw.description: on Minkowski space the sprinkling is Lorentz-invariant in distribution, the unique discretization respecting full Lorentz symmetry
